newsitem.title: USA: US spot propane firm to steady amid strong NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: US spot propane firm to steady amid strong NYMEX.

text.p: U.S. spot propane, a key liquefied petroleum gas, was firmer to steady in quiet trade on Thursday and amid a sharp rise in NYMEX futures.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane was up a quarter cent to between 34.50/34.75 cents a gallon, with deals done in the range.
Conway material was steady, with deals done at 34.50 cents.
The ethane markets were up on stronger NYMEX natgas futures as a heat wave drove up demand. Bevlieu ethane was at 20.00/20.25 cents and Conway material was at 16.50/17.00 cents.
